title: Left hand
goal: Find the bass position and play with your left hand.

steps.title: The lower keys
steps.text: Your left hand usually plays the lower keys, called the bass. Put your little finger (5) on the C below middle C.

steps.title: Left-hand fingers
steps.text: Here the little finger is 5 and the thumb is 1, so the numbers count down as you go up: C3 with 5, D with 4, E with 3, F with 2, G with 1.

steps.title: Find it
steps.prompt: Play the C below middle C

steps.title: Up with the left hand
steps.text: Play C D E F G with fingers 5 4 3 2 1.

steps.title: Back down
steps.text: Now G down to C, fingers 1 2 3 4 5.

steps.title: A bass line
steps.text: Low notes are often long and slow, like a steady floor under a tune. Next you play C and G, four beats each.

steps.title: C and G
steps.text: Play C, then G, then C, then G, and hold each for four beats.
